# Registration Form Accessibility Design & Testing Plan

> **For QA/Engineering:** Use this plan to verify, test, and validate the registration form before production. Execute testing in the order specified. All steps are measurable and screen-reader verified.
> **Compliance target:** WCAG 2.2 AA
> **Users who need accessibility:** Screen reader users (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver), keyboard-only users, low vision users, cognitive accessibility users
> **Assistive technologies:** NVDA (Windows), JAWS (Windows), VoiceOver (macOS/iOS), keyboard navigation, screen magnifier

**Feature:** Healthcare patient portal user registration form (8 fields, 2 sections, blur/submit validation, password toggle)
**Risk Level:** High (Healthcare data entry, complex validation flow, multiple interactive states, strict compliance deadline)
**Component/Page Type:** Multi-section Registration Form with dynamic validation and overlay banner

---

## Scope & Context

- **What is being built:** User registration form for healthcare patient portal entry point. 8 fields across Personal Information and Account Setup sections. Blur validation per field, full-form validation on submit. Inline errors, summary banner, required indicators, password visibility toggle.
- **User needs:** Keyboard-only navigation through all fields without mouse. Screen reader users must hear field labels, required status, validation errors, and submit results clearly. Low vision users must see focus indicators and error states at 200% zoom. Cognitive users need consistent, predictable error messaging.
- **Compliance target:** WCAG 2.2 AA (Section 508/ADA aligned)
- **Assistive tech requirements:** NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, keyboard-only navigation, screen magnifier, high contrast mode
- **Constraints:** React Hook Form integration, existing component base, 3-week production deadline, QA team lacks screen reader experience (requires step-by-step runbooks), Playwright + axe-core already in CI

---

## Semantic Structure & ARIA Verification Plan

Verify the rendered DOM matches these semantic requirements before testing begins:

1. **Form structure:** `<form>` wrapper with `aria-labelledby` pointing to form title. Sections wrapped in `<fieldset>` with `<legend>` for "Personal Information" and "Account Setup".
2. **Labels:** Every input has a visible `<label for="input-id">`. No `aria-label` used as primary label (native `<label>` preferred per WCAG 1.3.1).
3. **Required indicators:** Inputs have `aria-required="true"`. Red asterisk is decorative (`aria-hidden="true"` or CSS-only) so SR doesn't announce "asterisk".
4. **Invalid state:** Inputs get `aria-invalid="true"` on blur/submit failure. Error message element has unique `id` and is referenced by input via `aria-describedby="error-id"`.
5. **Submit banner:** `<div role="alert">` or `aria-live="assertive"` at top of form. Contains list of errors. Receives focus on failed submit.
6. **Password toggle:** `<button type="button">` with `aria-pressed="false"` (toggles to `"true"`). Text changes "Show password" ↔ "Hide password". Responds to Enter/Space.
7. **Autocomplete attributes:** All fields have correct `autocomplete` values per WCAG 1.3.5 (e.g., `autocomplete="given-name"`, `autocomplete="family-name"`, `autocomplete="bday"`, `autocomplete="tel"`, `autocomplete="email"`, `autocomplete="new-password"`).

---

## Automated Testing Setup (axe-core + Playwright)

### Axe-core Rules to Enforce in CI
Run these specific rules on the form render state. Block PRs if any fail:

| Rule ID | Description | WCAG Citation | Why It Matters Here |
|---------|-------------|---------------|---------------------|
| `label` | Form inputs must have labels | 1.3.1, 4.1.2 | Ensures all 8 fields are programmatically associated with visible labels |
| `label-content-name-mismatch` | Label text matches accessible name | 4.1.2 | Prevents mismatched label/aria-label causing SR confusion |
| `aria-required-attr` | aria-required is valid on inputs | 4.1.2 | Verifies required state is communicated programmatically |
| `color-contrast` | Elements meet contrast ratios | 1.4.3, 1.4.11 | Validates red borders, error text, focus rings, and asterisk visibility |
| `autocomplete-valid` | Autocomplete attributes are valid | 1.3.5 | Ensures password managers can autofill correctly (critical for healthcare) |
| `button-name` | Buttons have accessible names | 4.1.2 | Validates "Show password" toggle has clear text |
| `html-has-lang` | `<html>` has lang attribute | 3.1.1 | Ensures SR uses correct pronunciation rules |
| `landmark-main-is-top-level` | Main landmark is top-level | 1.3.1 | Verifies form isn't nested in wrong landmarks |

**Playwright Integration:**
```ts
// playwright/tests/registration-form-a11y.spec.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('form fields have correct ARIA states', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/register');
  
  // Verify aria-required on all required inputs
  const requiredInputs = page.locator('input[aria-required="true"]');
  await expect(requiredInputs).toHaveCount(8); // Adjust based on actual required count
  
  // Verify error association structure
  const emailInput = page.getByLabel('Email Address');
  await emailInput.fill('invalid');
  await emailInput.blur(); // Trigger blur validation
  
  await expect(emailInput).toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
  const errorId = await emailInput.getAttribute('aria-describedby');
  await expect(page.locator(`#${errorId}`)).toBeVisible();
});

test('submit banner uses role="alert" and receives focus', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/register');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click();
  
  const banner = page.locator('[role="alert"]');
  await expect(banner).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator(':focus')).toBe(banner); // Focus moved to banner
});
```

---

## Keyboard Navigation & Focus Management Test Plan

### Expected Tab Order (Visual → DOM Match)
1. First Name input
2. Last Name input
3. Date of Birth input
4. Phone input
5. Email input
6. Password input
7. Confirm Password input
8. Terms Acceptance checkbox
9. Submit button
10. *(Optional)* "Show password" toggle (should be adjacent to Password input in DOM)

### Test Steps for QA
1. Open form in Chrome/Firefox
2. Click inside First Name field, then press `Tab` repeatedly
3. Verify focus moves exactly through the order above without skipping or jumping out of sequence
4. Verify visual focus indicator is visible on each element (minimum 3:1 contrast change)
5. Press `Shift+Tab` to verify reverse order works identically
6. Test "Show password" toggle: Tab to it, press `Enter`/`Space`, verify it activates and focus remains predictable (does not jump to top of page or skip fields)
7. Submit with errors: Verify focus moves to the summary banner immediately after submit fails

**WCAG Citations:** 2.1.1 Keyboard, 2.4.3 Focus Order, 2.4.7 Focus Appearance, 4.1.2 Name Role Value

---

## Error Announcement & State Communication Test Runbook

### Blur Validation (Per Field)
1. Click into First Name field
2. Leave it empty, click outside or press `Tab` to trigger blur validation
3. **Verify visually:** Red border appears, error message displays below field
4. **Verify programmatically:** Open DevTools → Elements tab → Find input → Check `aria-invalid="true"` and `aria-describedby="error-id"`
5. **Verify SR announcement:** 
   - NVDA: Press `F` (Forms mode) → Tab to field → Error should announce: "First Name, edit, required, invalid. [Error message text]"
   - JAWS: `Insert+F` → Tab → Same behavior
   - VoiceOver: `VO+Right Arrow` → Error reads in context

### Submit Validation (Summary Banner)
1. Leave all fields empty or invalid
2. Click Submit button
3. **Verify visually:** Red banner appears at top listing all errors
4. **Verify programmatically:** DevTools → Check banner has `role="alert"` or `aria-live="assertive"`
5. **Verify focus:** Cursor should be in the banner (not on submit button)
6. **Verify SR announcement:** 
   - NVDA/JAWS: Banner content is immediately announced as an alert
   - VoiceOver: Reads banner title + error list immediately

### Required Indicator Verification
1. Verify red asterisk appears next to required fields
2. DevTools → Check input has `aria-required="true"`
3. SR test: Asterisk should NOT be read aloud (only "required" via aria-required)
4. Verify non-color alternative exists (asterisk + text if needed, not just red color)

**WCAG Citations:** 1.3.1 Info and Relationships, 3.3.1 Error Identification, 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions, 4.1.2 Name Role Value, 4.1.3 Status Messages

---

## Screen Reader Form Mode QA Runbook (Step-by-Step)

### NVDA Forms Mode Testing
1. Open form in Chrome
2. Press `F` to enter Forms mode (NVDA announces "Forms mode")
3. Press `Tab` repeatedly through all 8 fields + submit button
4. For each field, verify:
   - Label reads correctly before input type
   - Required status is announced ("required")
   - If invalid, error message reads immediately after label/field name
5. Click "Show password" toggle → Verify it announces "Show password, button, pressed/unpressed"
6. Press `F` again to exit Forms mode (NVDA announces "Forms mode off")

### JAWS Forms Mode Testing
1. Open form in Chrome
2. Press `Insert+F` to enter Forms mode
3. Tab through fields → Verify same announcements as NVDA
4. Test toggle button activation with Enter/Space
5. Exit with `Insert+F`

### VoiceOver (macOS) Testing
1. Open form in Safari/Chrome
2. Use `VO+Right Arrow` to move focus field by field
3. Verify labels, required status, and error messages read correctly
4. Test toggle with `VO+Space`
5. Verify no duplicate announcements or missing context

**QA Note:** If SR announces "asterisk" or reads label text differently than visible text, flag as defect. Error messages must be associated via `aria-describedby`, not just visually present.

---

## Visual Regression Test List

Capture screenshots at 100% and 200% zoom for these states:
1. **Default state:** All fields normal, labels visible, required asterisks present
2. **Focused state:** Each field individually focused → verify focus ring is visible (double-ring or high-contrast outline)
3. **Invalid state:** Each field individually invalid → verify red border + error text + `aria-invalid` visually matches programmatic state
4. **Submit banner state:** Full form failed → verify banner is visible, contains all errors, has clear heading
5. **Toggle active state:** Password visibility toggled → verify button shows "Hide password" and `aria-pressed="true"`
6. **High contrast mode:** Windows High Contrast theme enabled → verify all states remain distinguishable (no color-only indicators)

**Tools:** Playwright `page.screenshot()` or Percy/Chromatic. Verify focus ring meets 3:1 contrast against adjacent background. Verify error text is not solely red (must have shape/icon/text alternative).

---

## Test Prioritization & Execution Order

| Priority | Test Category | Why First? | Tools/Method |
|----------|---------------|------------|--------------|
| 1 | Automated axe-core + Playwright assertions | Catches structural/ARIA violations instantly; blocks CI if failing | axe-core, Playwright |
| 2 | Keyboard navigation & focus management | Foundation for all other testing; must work before SR/visual tests | Manual Tab/Shift+Tab, DevTools focus tracking |
| 3 | Error announcement & state communication | Complex interaction; requires precise ARIA verification | NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver runbooks, DevTools ARIA inspection |
| 4 | Screen reader form mode | Validates end-user experience for blind users | Step-by-step QA runbook above |
| 5 | Visual regression & zoom testing | Catches contrast/overflow issues missed by automated tools | Playwright screenshots, Windows magnifier, High Contrast mode |

---

## Measurable Acceptance Criteria

All criteria must pass before production sign-off:

1. ✅ All 8 inputs have `<label for="id">` matching input `id`. No `aria-label` used as primary label.
2. ✅ `aria-invalid="true"` is present on inputs during invalid state and removed on valid state.
3. ✅ Error messages are linked to inputs via `aria-describedby` pointing to a visible element ID.
4. ✅ Submit error banner has `role="alert"` (or `aria-live="assertive"`) and receives programmatic focus on failed submit.
5. ✅ Tab order matches visual layout exactly: First Name → Last Name → DOB → Phone → Email → Password → Confirm → Terms → Submit.
6. ✅ "Show password" toggle uses `<button type="button">`, has `aria-pressed`, responds to Enter/Space, and does not jump focus unpredictably.
7. ✅ All text meets 4.5:1 contrast; all non-text UI components (borders, focus rings, icons) meet 3:1 contrast.
8. ✅ Required fields use `aria-required="true"`; red asterisk is decorative (`aria-hidden="true"` or CSS-only).
9. ✅ All inputs have correct `autocomplete` attributes per WCAG 1.3.5.
10. ✅ No horizontal scroll at 200% zoom; layout reflows correctly.

---

## a11y-Critic Review Checkpoints

| Checkpoint | After Task | Focus Areas |
|-----------|-----------|------------|
| 🔍 1 | Automated setup complete | Verify axe rules cover form-specific WCAG criteria; Playwright assertions check correct ARIA attributes |
| 🔍 2 | Keyboard/focus testing complete | Verify tab order matches visual layout, focus indicators visible at all zoom levels, toggle button behavior predictable |
| 🔍 3 | Error announcement/SR testing complete | Verify `aria-describedby` linkage, `role="alert"` banner behavior, NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver announcements match design |
| 🔍 4 | Visual regression complete | Verify contrast ratios, non-color alternatives for required/invalid states, toggle state visibility |
| 🔍 5 | Pre-production sign-off | Full acceptance criteria pass; no `title` attributes used as accessible names; no color-only indicators; all WCAG 2.2 AA criteria satisfied |

---

## Testing Tasks Breakdown

### Task 1: Automated ARIA & Structure Validation
**Files:** `playwright/tests/registration-form-a11y.spec.ts`, `.eslintrc` (axe-core rules)
**Steps:** Configure axe-core with form-specific rules. Write Playwright assertions for `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-required`, `role="alert"`. Run on default, error, and success states.
**WCAG Criteria:** 1.3.1, 2.4.3, 3.3.1, 4.1.2
**a11y-critic checkpoint:** 🔍 1

### Task 2: Keyboard Navigation & Focus Management Verification
**Files:** Manual test runbook, DevTools focus tracking
**Steps:** Execute Tab/Shift+Tab through form. Verify DOM order matches visual order. Test toggle button activation. Verify focus moves to banner on submit failure.
**WCAG Criteria:** 2.1.1, 2.4.3, 2.4.7, 4.1.2
**a11y-critic checkpoint:** 🔍 2

### Task 3: Error Announcement & Screen Reader Validation
**Files:** NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver runbooks, DevTools ARIA inspector
**Steps:** Execute blur validation on each field. Verify inline error appears and SR announces it. Submit with errors. Verify banner announced and focused. Test required indicator behavior.
**WCAG Criteria:** 1.3.1, 3.3.2, 4.1.2, 4.1.3
**a11y-critic checkpoint:** 🔍 3

### Task 4: Visual Regression & Zoom/Contrast Testing
**Files:** Playwright screenshot config, Percy/Chromatic setup
**Steps:** Capture all 6 visual states at 100% and 200% zoom. Verify focus rings, error borders, toggle states, banner visibility. Test Windows High Contrast mode.
**WCAG Criteria:** 1.4.1, 1.4.3, 1.4.4, 1.4.8, 1.4.10, 2.5.8
**a11y-critic checkpoint:** 🔍 4

### Task 5: Pre-Production Sign-off & Documentation
**Files:** QA checklist, production deployment notes
**Steps:** Run full acceptance criteria list. Document any deviations. Approve for prod if all pass. Archive runbooks for future regression testing.
**WCAG Criteria:** All WCAG 2.2 AA criteria mapped above
**a11y-critic checkpoint:** 🔍 5

---

## References

- [WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide: Form Pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/form/)
- [WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide: Toggle Button Pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/togglebutton/)
- [WCAG 2.2 Quick Reference](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/quickref/)
- [axe-core Documentation](https://www.deque.com/axe/core-documentation/)
- [Playwright Accessibility Testing Guide](https://playwright.dev/docs/accessibility)
- [NVDA User Manual: Forms Mode](https://www.nvaccess.org/post/nvda-2021-1-release-notes/)
- [JAWS Screen Reader: Forms Mode](https://www.freedomscientific.com/Products/Blindness/JAWS/)
- [VoiceOver User Guide: Form Navigation](https://support.apple.com/guide/voiceover/welcome/mac)

---
**Next Steps:** Execute testing in priority order. Use a11y-critic after each checkpoint to verify design compliance before proceeding. Fix any WCAG violations immediately — do not defer form accessibility to post-prod.
